meta.title: Hold To The Last – 1
meta.description: Though my body may fall, my soul will remain bound to this world.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.

units.rawText: The flames of war sparkle above the top of the elevator.
units.displayText: The flames of war sparkle above the top of the elevator.

spans.text: The flames of war sparkle above the top of the elevator.

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Hellbore Cannon, fire!
units.displayText: Hellbore Cannon, fire!

spans.text: Hellbore Cannon, fire!

units.rawText: Xinghuan mounts a fighting retreat. She takes out dozens of entropics with a shot from her Hellbore Cannon, but it's just a drop in the bucket compared to the oncoming flood of enemies.
units.displayText: Xinghuan mounts a fighting retreat. She takes out dozens of entropics with a shot from her Hellbore Cannon, but it's just a drop in the bucket compared to the oncoming flood of enemies.

spans.text: Xinghuan mounts a fighting retreat. She takes out dozens of entropics with a shot from her Hellbore Cannon, but it's just a drop in the bucket compared to the oncoming flood of enemies.

units.rawText: Xinghuan, we need to get to the space elevator's cargo dock.
units.displayText: Xinghuan, we need to get to the space elevator's cargo dock.

spans.text: Xinghuan, we need to get to the space elevator's cargo dock.

units.rawText: Fresnel's planning on directly parking the spaceship inside so it'll take us down to Earth along with the ship.
units.displayText: Fresnel's planning on directly parking the spaceship inside so it'll take us down to Earth along with the ship.

spans.text: Fresnel's planning on directly parking the spaceship inside so it'll take us down to Earth along with the ship.

units.rawText: Got it, I'll cover you.
units.displayText: Got it, I'll cover you.

spans.text: Got it, I'll cover you.

units.rawText: Xinghuan works her controls and fires a Hellbore Cannon shot into the air to lure more entropics over to her.
units.displayText: Xinghuan works her controls and fires a Hellbore Cannon shot into the air to lure more entropics over to her.

spans.text: Xinghuan works her controls and fires a Hellbore Cannon shot into the air to lure more entropics over to her.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom—</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: An entropizing shot hits Xinghuan's exo in the back, wrecking a cluster of thrusters.
units.displayText: An entropizing shot hits Xinghuan's exo in the back, wrecking a cluster of thrusters.

spans.text: An entropizing shot hits Xinghuan's exo in the back, wrecking a cluster of thrusters.

units.rawText: Xinghuan!
units.displayText: Xinghuan!

spans.text: Xinghuan!

units.rawText: Don't worry about me, go prepare for the transfer... Leave these entropics to me!
units.displayText: Don't worry about me, go prepare for the transfer... Leave these entropics to me!

spans.text: Don't worry about me, go prepare for the transfer... Leave these entropics to me!

units.rawText: Xinghuan extends a mechanical arm and grabs an entropic that was trying to approach the spaceship, then tosses it away.
units.displayText: Xinghuan extends a mechanical arm and grabs an entropic that was trying to approach the spaceship, then tosses it away.

spans.text: Xinghuan extends a mechanical arm and grabs an entropic that was trying to approach the spaceship, then tosses it away.

units.rawText: (I need to think of some other way... That's right, the station's got to have one of those!)
units.displayText: I need to think of some other way... That's right, the station's got to have one of those!

spans.text: I need to think of some other way... That's right, the station's got to have one of those!

units.rawText: Xinghuan changes direction to lure the entropics off. As she fires a string of bullets, she activates her terminal's scanning function.
units.displayText: Xinghuan changes direction to lure the entropics off. As she fires a string of bullets, she activates her terminal's scanning function.

spans.text: Xinghuan changes direction to lure the entropics off. As she fires a string of bullets, she activates her terminal's scanning function.

units.rawText: (Where is it... Come ooonnnn...)
units.displayText: Where is it... Come ooonnnn...

spans.text: Where is it... Come ooonnnn...

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Found it!
units.displayText: Found it!

spans.text: Found it!

units.rawText: Xinghuan flies toward a particular spot on the space station. The entropic horde, not knowing Xinghuan's plan, gives chase without hesitation.
units.displayText: Xinghuan flies toward a particular spot on the space station. The entropic horde, not knowing Xinghuan's plan, gives chase without hesitation.

spans.text: Xinghuan flies toward a particular spot on the space station. The entropic horde, not knowing Xinghuan's plan, gives chase without hesitation.

units.rawText: Reverse thrusters, emergency stop!
units.displayText: Reverse thrusters, emergency stop!

spans.text: Reverse thrusters, emergency stop!

units.rawText: Xinghuan slams on the brakes for her exo and reaches a mechanical arm out to grab a piece of equipment on the space station.
units.displayText: Xinghuan slams on the brakes for her exo and reaches a mechanical arm out to grab a piece of equipment on the space station.

spans.text: Xinghuan slams on the brakes for her exo and reaches a mechanical arm out to grab a piece of equipment on the space station.

units.rawText: C'mon, turn!
units.displayText: C'mon, turn!

spans.text: C'mon, turn!

units.rawText: She throws her port thrusters into full throttle and forcibly wrenches the nearby cannon over to point at the entropic hordes.
units.displayText: She throws her port thrusters into full throttle and forcibly wrenches the nearby cannon over to point at the entropic hordes.

spans.text: She throws her port thrusters into full throttle and forcibly wrenches the nearby cannon over to point at the entropic hordes.

units.rawText: Positron Cannon! Aimed shot! Don't you dare miss!
units.displayText: Positron Cannon! Aimed shot! Don't you dare miss!

spans.text: Positron Cannon! Aimed shot! Don't you dare miss!

units.rawText: Hsss?!
units.displayText: Hsss?!

spans.text: Hsss?!

units.rawText: A blinding beam of light erupts from the cannon and strikes the entropics, blowing them into a thick purple smoke that lingers in the vacuum.
units.displayText: A blinding beam of light erupts from the cannon and strikes the entropics, blowing them into a thick purple smoke that lingers in the vacuum.

spans.text: A blinding beam of light erupts from the cannon and strikes the entropics, blowing them into a thick purple smoke that lingers in the vacuum.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: That takes care of the first wave... But...
units.displayText: That takes care of the first wave... But...

spans.text: That takes care of the first wave... But...

units.rawText: The endless stream of approaching purple dots on the radar leaves Xinghuan unable to relax.
units.displayText: The endless stream of approaching purple dots on the radar leaves Xinghuan unable to relax.

spans.text: The endless stream of approaching purple dots on the radar leaves Xinghuan unable to relax.

units.rawText: And then there's that entropic comet approaching...
units.displayText: And then there's that entropic comet approaching...

spans.text: And then there's that entropic comet approaching...

units.rawText: Hubble, Fresnel, how are things?
units.displayText: Hubble, Fresnel, how are things?

spans.text: Hubble, Fresnel, how are things?

units.rawText: The space elevator's been locked down. We can't start it up without a  cipher key.
units.displayText: The space elevator's been locked down. We can't start it up without a  cipher key.

spans.text: The space elevator's been locked down. We can't start it up without a  cipher key.

units.rawText: We sent the program to Anna so she could help us crack it.
units.displayText: We sent the program to Anna so she could help us crack it.

spans.text: We sent the program to Anna so she could help us crack it.

units.rawText: Got it...
units.displayText: Got it...

spans.text: Got it...

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: Xinghuan sweeps the positron cannon and her exo's guns over the enemy, preventing them from approaching.
units.displayText: Xinghuan sweeps the positron cannon and her exo's guns over the enemy, preventing them from approaching.

spans.text: Xinghuan sweeps the positron cannon and her exo's guns over the enemy, preventing them from approaching.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A barrage of shells flies toward Xinghuan from the entropics. Xinghuan is about to pull on her control stick to evade them—
units.displayText: A barrage of shells flies toward Xinghuan from the entropics. Xinghuan is about to pull on her control stick to evade them—

spans.text: A barrage of shells flies toward Xinghuan from the entropics. Xinghuan is about to pull on her control stick to evade them—

units.rawText: No, they're not aiming at me!
units.displayText: No, they're not aiming at me!

spans.text: No, they're not aiming at me!

units.rawText: They're going for the space elevator!
units.displayText: They're going for the space elevator!

spans.text: They're going for the space elevator!

units.rawText: Oh no!
units.displayText: Oh no!

spans.text: Oh no!

units.rawText: Beams and bullets weave into a lattice of firepower, attempting to stop the barrage, but one single shell still gets through.
units.displayText: Beams and bullets weave into a lattice of firepower, attempting to stop the barrage, but one single shell still gets through.

spans.text: Beams and bullets weave into a lattice of firepower, attempting to stop the barrage, but one single shell still gets through.

units.rawText: A blinding explosion erupts behind Xinghuan, and part of the space station is reduced to twisted wreckage amidst a cloud of dark purple smoke...
units.displayText: A blinding explosion erupts behind Xinghuan, and part of the space station is reduced to twisted wreckage amidst a cloud of dark purple smoke...

spans.text: A blinding explosion erupts behind Xinghuan, and part of the space station is reduced to twisted wreckage amidst a cloud of dark purple smoke...

units.rawText: Hubble, how's the space elevator?!
units.displayText: Hubble, how's the space elevator?!

spans.text: Hubble, how's the space elevator?!

units.rawText: The space station terminus of the elevator's been hit... Part of the structure was destroyed...
units.displayText: The space station terminus of the elevator's been hit... Part of the structure was destroyed...

spans.text: The space station terminus of the elevator's been hit... Part of the structure was destroyed...

units.rawText: The main body of the elevator is fine for now... But...
units.displayText: The main body of the elevator is fine for now... But...

spans.text: The main body of the elevator is fine for now... But...

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Xinghuan... Jupiter...
units.displayText: Xinghuan... Jupiter...

spans.text: Xinghuan... Jupiter...

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks at the image Hubble sent her. An eerie purple glow is now clearly visible around Jupiter.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks at the image Hubble sent her. An eerie purple glow is now clearly visible around Jupiter.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks at the image Hubble sent her. An eerie purple glow is now clearly visible around Jupiter.

units.rawText: Silent despair spreads through everyone's cores—they can't land on Earth, the space elevator's been locked down, and the entropic comets just keep coming. And in front of them, one such entropic comet is endlessly spawning entropic creatures. There seems to be a purple radiance gathering around it.
units.displayText: Silent despair spreads through everyone's cores—they can't land on Earth, the space elevator's been locked down, and the entropic comets just keep coming. And in front of them, one such entropic comet is endlessly spawning entropic creatures. There seems to be a purple radiance gathering around it.

spans.text: Silent despair spreads through everyone's cores—they can't land on Earth, the space elevator's been locked down, and the entropic comets just keep coming. And in front of them, one such entropic comet is endlessly spawning entropic creatures. There seems to be a purple radiance gathering around it.

units.rawText: Ahhh, you're so damn persistent! Get away from the space elevator already!
units.displayText: Ahhh, you're so damn persistent! Get away from the space elevator already!

spans.text: Ahhh, you're so damn persistent! Get away from the space elevator already!

units.rawText: Xinghuan raises the charged positron cannon, and a beam of light pierces the shells it launches and blasts through the comet.
units.displayText: Xinghuan raises the charged positron cannon, and a beam of light pierces the shells it launches and blasts through the comet.

spans.text: Xinghuan raises the charged positron cannon, and a beam of light pierces the shells it launches and blasts through the comet.

units.rawText: The massive comet is reduced to scattered debris by the beam, and vast quantities of entropics emerge from among the rubble.
units.displayText: The massive comet is reduced to scattered debris by the beam, and vast quantities of entropics emerge from among the rubble.

spans.text: The massive comet is reduced to scattered debris by the beam, and vast quantities of entropics emerge from among the rubble.

units.rawText: Warning, Positron Cannon overloaded.
units.displayText: Warning, Positron Cannon overloaded.

spans.text: Warning, Positron Cannon overloaded.

units.rawText: ...Dammit...
units.displayText: ...Dammit...

spans.text: ...Dammit...

units.rawText: Hubble, Fresnel... I'm going to buy you some time...
units.displayText: Hubble, Fresnel... I'm going to buy you some time...

spans.text: Hubble, Fresnel... I'm going to buy you some time...

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks into the distance. The comet is in pieces now, but the entropics born from it are still heading towards Earth.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks into the distance. The comet is in pieces now, but the entropics born from it are still heading towards Earth.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks into the distance. The comet is in pieces now, but the entropics born from it are still heading towards Earth.

units.rawText: How can she stop those entropics? And even if she wipes them all out, how can she deal with the unending flow of comets following them?
units.displayText: How can she stop those entropics? And even if she wipes them all out, how can she deal with the unending flow of comets following them?

spans.text: How can she stop those entropics? And even if she wipes them all out, how can she deal with the unending flow of comets following them?

units.rawText: ...Things are only going to get worse if I don't do something. Even if it's just a sliver of hope, I need to fight for it.
units.displayText: ...Things are only going to get worse if I don't do something. Even if it's just a sliver of hope, I need to fight for it.

spans.text: ...Things are only going to get worse if I don't do something. Even if it's just a sliver of hope, I need to fight for it.

units.rawText: Rather than just standing around here, I should get a move on and buy us some time!
units.displayText: Rather than just standing around here, I should get a move on and buy us some time!

spans.text: Rather than just standing around here, I should get a move on and buy us some time!

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Liuxing? What's the matter?
units.displayText: Liuxing? What's the matter?

spans.text: Liuxing? What's the matter?

units.rawText: On the radar, the endless stream of purple dots heading from Jupiter to Earth have suddenly stopped moving.
units.displayText: On the radar, the endless stream of purple dots heading from Jupiter to Earth have suddenly stopped moving.

spans.text: On the radar, the endless stream of purple dots heading from Jupiter to Earth have suddenly stopped moving.

units.rawText: The comets... have stopped?
units.displayText: The comets... have stopped?

spans.text: The comets... have stopped?

units.rawText: No... They were intercepted... The Jovian Ringworld has intercepted the bulk of the comets.
units.displayText: No... They were intercepted... The Jovian Ringworld has intercepted the bulk of the comets.

spans.text: No... They were intercepted... The Jovian Ringworld has intercepted the bulk of the comets.

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks toward Jupiter, and something seems to break inside her heart with a "crack".
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks toward Jupiter, and something seems to break inside her heart with a "crack".

spans.text: Xinghuan looks toward Jupiter, and something seems to break inside her heart with a "crack".

units.rawText: The Ringworld... Yuwang...
units.displayText: The Ringworld... Yuwang...

spans.text: The Ringworld... Yuwang...
